titulo.alumno: First and then · Telling events in order

intro: Part 1: first and then. Read the heading and find the detail that answers the question.

texto: A narrative organises events with «først», «bagefter» and «til sidst». Check what happened before and what changed afterwards; the order of the sentences does not always match the time order.
Read the heading and find the detail that answers the question.
